semantics.alias_rule: fresh output delegated to the sole canonical color traversal
semantics.shape_rule: preserves rank and shape and requires exactly three channels at the third-from-final axis
semantics.accumulation_dtype: F32 CIE Lab inverse, XYZ matrix, and piecewise sRGB transfer
semantics.layout_rule: logical strided color reads and contiguous output in the input logical shape
semantics.device_rule: CPU ordinal zero on the input stream; other native devices fail typed
semantics.numeric_rule: Kornia 0.8.2 D65 CIE-Lab-to-sRGB inverse with clip=true
semantics.determinism: fixed canonical pixel and channel traversal with fixed matrix order
semantics.cancellation_points: before validation, at bounded pixel intervals, and before publication
semantics.vjp_rule: analytical transpose of the clipped piecewise Lab-to-RGB Jacobian
semantics.jvp_rule: analytical clipped piecewise Lab-to-RGB Jacobian applied to the tangent
